description.chatFlavor: Move up to 30 ft using the motorbike. Movement is manual.
After moving at least 10 ft straight toward the target, ram it. STR save on hit or push 10 ft. If the run-up was at least 20 ft, manually add 1d8 bludgeoning.
Creatures within 5 ft make a Dexterity save; roll 2d6 bludgeoning, half on success. Save handling is manual.
First strike of a two-hit revving cut.
On a confirmed hit, engage the chainsaw with that target until the start of your next turn, unlocking Rip Through.
Requires a target currently engaged by Grind. Engagement ends after this attack.
Spin up the chaingun. Full Auto remains available while you stay in Chaingun Mode.
First shot of a five-shot Full Auto sequence. Requires Spin Up.
Move up to 15 ft and fire two shots during that movement. Movement is manual.

description.value:
Motorbike / Chainsaw / Chaingun

A three-mode transforming weapon platform.

Motorbike: Drive, Ram, Burnout.

Chainsaw: Chainsaw Slash, Revving Cut, Grind, Rip Through.

Chaingun: Chaingun Burst, Spin Up, Full Auto, Strafing Fire.

Mode changes are Bonus Actions. Switching away from Chaingun ends Spin Up. Switching away from Chainsaw clears Grind engagement.

Movement, push, and save riders are manual.
